note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 9568 Section 8.1.1 says "The IPv4 source address of an ICMP redirect should be the address that the end-host used when making its next-hop routing decision." TestVRRPRedirectSourceFollowsVirtualMAC, otherwise unchanged, pins the reverse route through the parent with source 192.0.2.254, then requires each of two virtual MACs to draw a redirect sourced from its own virtual address and the physical MAC to draw one from 192.0.2.254. Verdict enforced.
